When K is odd, odd-index multipliers contribute a binary factor and force all even indices n>=6 to have b_n odd; direct mod-12 computation treats n=4. In each branch all hypotheses, endpoint indices and cases are handled. Reproducible unbounded and modular recurrence tests passed, but the infinite proof is symbolic.

value.rationale: The source studies the whole parameter K family but has only a K=2 binary staircase. The new sharp parity phase diagram is a natural complete structural classification across every positive coefficient. It establishes a qualitative finite-versus-infinite dichotomy, exact even-coefficient binary supports with adjustable stride and exact valuations, and a genuinely exceptional odd-parameter mod-12 boundary. This answers a meaningful recurrence-structure question without asserting a larger prime-only classification. The K=2 special case is acknowledged, not counted as a new result.
